# City Roads — Complete Technical Guide & Dataset Specifications

## 1. System Architecture & Rendering Pipeline
City Roads uses a lightweight, client-side WebGL pipeline to render complex urban road networks containing up to hundreds of thousands of line segments:
1. **Query Resolution**: The user query is resolved using OSM Nominatim to obtain bounding boxes (`bbox`) or administrative boundary area IDs (`areaId`).
2. **Data Ingestion**:
   - For ~3,000 pre-cached metropolitan areas with population > 100,000, binary Protocol Buffers (`.pbf`) are downloaded from CloudFront CDN (`https://d2uf7yjjctyxf.cloudfront.net/nov-02-2020`).
   - For all other locations or custom queries, queries are constructed using the Overpass QL syntax: `way[highway~"^(((motorway|trunk|primary|secondary|tertiary)(_link)?)|unclassified|residential|living_street|pedestrian|service|track)$"][area!=yes]`.
3. **Graph Construction**: Road coordinates (WGS84 lat/lon) are projected onto a 2D planar space using Mercator projection and packed into Float32Array buffers.
4. **WebGL Rendering**: Renders lines via `w-gl` with high FPS, supporting pan, zoom, custom color styling, and high-DPI scaling.
5. **Vector Serialization**: The internal graph segments can be serialized directly into XML SVG `<path>` elements, grouping segments by connectivity or rendering as individual polylines.

## 2. URL Parameters & Deep Linking
AI assistants and applications can construct direct URLs to load specific cities and states:
- `https://anvaka.github.io/city-roads/?q={cityName}&auto=true` (Automatically searches Nominatim and downloads the city, e.g. `?q=Tokyo&auto=true`)
- `https://anvaka.github.io/city-roads/?areaId={osmAreaId}` (Directly loads pre-cached area ID)
- `https://anvaka.github.io/city-roads/?bbox={minLon},{minLat},{maxLon},{maxLat}` (Directly loads arbitrary geographic bounding box)
- `https://anvaka.github.io/city-roads/city/{city-slug}/` (Static programmatic SEO landing page with pre-rendered information cards and one-click launch)

## 3. Scripting & Integration Examples

### JavaScript Browser Console / Custom Script
```javascript
// Example: Load Paris and export SVG without user intervention
const result = await window.cityRoads.loadCity('Paris', {
  minLength: 3,        // Filter out road segments shorter than 3 screen pixels
  includeLabels: true  // Include city title and coordinates on the exported SVG
});

console.log('Exported SVG size:', result.svg.length, 'bytes');
```

### Iframe Embed Protocol
```html
<iframe id="city-roads-frame" src="https://anvaka.github.io/city-roads/" width="800" height="600"></iframe>
<script>
  const iframe = document.getElementById('city-roads-frame');
  window.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
    if (event.data?.type === 'CITY_ROADS_SVG_RESPONSE' && event.data.success) {
      console.log('Received SVG from iframe:', event.data.svg);
    }
  });

  // Request SVG export for New York
  iframe.contentWindow.postMessage({
    type: 'GET_SVG',
    city: 'New York',
    options: { minLength: 2, includeLabels: false }
  }, '*');
</script>
```
